Pricing questions

Which plan should I choose?
Most families pick Couples & pairs — it covers both parents (or a couple) on one bill and is our most popular plan. Choose Individual for one person, or Family if you're protecting up to four people, like both parents plus an aunt or in-law. You can move up a plan anytime.
Why does this cost more than a call blocker?
A blocker filters some scams. ScamPrep changes what happens when one gets through — and one always gets through. What you're paying for is a skill, plus monthly proof it's growing.
When can we start?
Family plans open this fall, in small onboarding cohorts — join the early-access list and you're at the front. Every plan will start with a 14-day free trial and carry a 60-day money-back guarantee.
What if my parent doesn't want it?
Then we don't enroll them. Nobody gets drilled without their own yes — and many parents warm up after seeing a sample drill. Most people enjoy being good at this.
Contracts?
None. Monthly plans cancel anytime; annual plans refund unused months.
